title: One-sided connected trace bound in the binary Hayes identity path
statement: Let ell >= 200, let n be 2 ell + 1 or 2 ell + 2, put c=ceil(log2 ell), a=ell-c-1, W=2^ceil(n/2) sum_{1<=j<a}(j-1)2^(j-1), and C=2^ell N_ell(1)-2^(a-1)N_{a-1}(1). Then C>-(2^(2ell)-W).

provenance.source: Axeyum gf2-lemire lane; one-sided repricing of the exact identity-path Haar telescope

notes: This is the selected open REL statement. The native population_refinement_one_sided_connected_implication operation proves that REL, together with the already proved low-conductor Weil envelope, yields N_ell(1)>2^(n-ell)-2^ell at both endpoints. It retains cancellation across ceil(log2 ell)+2 conductor levels and permits arbitrary positive trace. At ell=200 the exact saving required over the separate-level Weil envelope is 626 rather than the earlier symmetric target's 1583.
